image_qa.note: Both new editorial bodies and the library enhancement are intentionally image-free. Their only image element is the existing Big Bud Man logo or established hub imagery in shared site chrome; no delivery, flower, package, seller, or affiliate image is represented or linked.

search_console.decision: The report covered August 24 through September 20: 518 impressions, one click, 0.2% CTR, and average position 61.6. The only position 4-20 page rows had one to four impressions, so no data-led rewrite was justified; those tiny samples and the single Oklahoma query click were deliberately ignored. Old submitted-sitemap errors were checked against the current live sitemap, feed, and site index rather than treated as a new topic signal.

authority.action: Published a New York OCM- and FTC-grounded delivery-order evidence chain covering license, domain, cart, payment, ID, handoff, receipt, package, and complaint routes. Published a New York OCM-grounded flower freshness worksheet that separates six date types, exact-lot testing, package condition, recall status, storage, return policy, and value without diagnosing mold or inventing shelf life. Exposed each guide's review date in the library and added accessible sorting by recent review or title. The New York State Division of Consumer Protection was logged as a qualified consumer-resource opportunity; no outreach was sent.
